# Paired original-Reader versus rank-only control — future postrun gate

**Research only. No new Reader inference, new human sufficiency review, learned-memory training, or production activation is generated by this patch.** This is a stacked independent analysis addition to the rank-only null PR #2156, itself based on PR #2067. The parent v3 Reader branch remains untouched so its queued inference workflow is not invalidated or cancelled by changes to the experiment source commit.

## Exact preregistration and existing source-only result

- Registered v3 nine-question Git plan, exact byte SHA-256: `6f5efd713be88097cdc5ed3b93786df61e5dbc1709e512884952770dc9377608`. The earlier v1/v2 versions are retired and are **not comparable**.
- Six-project original Git archive ZIP SHA-256: `a4c7b9868461c11558546bd582796255cbca682c938a1704d62cd93a556406b4`. Independently reopened binary-blob ZIP SHA-256: `59dee0a84099f6fb101dbfd5420c569f10c44a2d8a7b67c984e381edf4db9d36`.
- **Observed original-source, zero-model shortcut: 7/9** exact answers simply by returning the first lexical retrieved file marker and `[E1]`. Two questions' targets are ranked second. Three repository-name groups are not three independently certified source-family samples.

## New independent verifier

`scripts/memory_cell/real_source_rank_paired_gate.py` is a **post-generation** gate. It requires the actual original complete **36-row JSONL generation journal for each of the two frozen Reader tiers** plus externally registered SHA-256 hashes of the **entire byte files**. It verifies the complete 72-attempt census and rejects malformed/duplicate JSON fields, mismatched byte pins, invalid v1/v2 plans, changed Git sources, source-delivery or Reader identity drift, omitted/duplicated calls, and invalid complete-evidence citations. It calls the existing independent original Git + `EvidenceBundle` scorer before any pairing.

For **`hybrid_k4`** and **`removed_declaration`**, it generates per-question matched outcomes against rank one, Reader wins/losses/ties, full target-marker citations, root-level deltas, and **the within-Reader original-versus-symbol-lesion contrast**. Each source-derived case remains in the denominator, even if a model call fails. It does not reconstruct, rewrite, or copy raw model answer text into the published report, just SHA-256 digests and outcomes.

Crucially, a correct Reader answer on one of the seven rank-one tasks is **not** credited as incremental source-use capability. Only two of nine cases have any possible incremental rank-correctness headroom. The original versus fully lesioned contrast is mechanistic, not a proof that the declaration was causally necessary or semantically sufficient. Root-level descriptive deltas **do not** become a statistically qualified 95% interval: there are only three exposed repository proxies. Both pretrained-weight authenticity and independent human judgment remain outside the scope of hashes.

## Run only after real original Reader files exist

```bash
export PYTHONPATH=scripts/memory_cell
python3 scripts/memory_cell/real_source_rank_paired_gate.py \
  --source-zip EXACT_SIX_PROJECT_SOURCE.zip \
  --reopen-zip EXACT_INDEPENDENT_REOPEN.zip \
  --smol-135m ORIGINAL_36_CALLS_SMALL.jsonl \
  --smol-135m-sha256 EXTERNALLY_RECORDED_ORIGINAL_SMALL_FILE_SHA256 \
  --smol-1.7b ORIGINAL_36_CALLS_LARGE.jsonl \
  --smol-1.7b-sha256 EXTERNALLY_RECORDED_ORIGINAL_LARGE_FILE_SHA256 \
  --output NEW_UNWRITTEN_PAIRED_REPORT.json
```

The dedicated source-only workflow tests the verifier on synthetic **fake journal rows**, with the **real, original SHA-verified six-project corpus**. **9 new fail-closed test methods** prove report accounting and tamper refusal, not pretrained inference; the workflow must not publish their 9/9 synthetic correctness as real model performance. The real job has to finish, both original journal hashes must be pinned **independently**, and then this gate can produce an actual model-vs-rank report. Do not substitute the previously completed 128-call native LoCoMo/LongMemEval pilot, whose questions and metrics differ from the v3 nine-question task.

`independent_human_sufficient_contexts=false`, `independent_95_percent_interval=null`, `parameter_learning_gain_established=false`, `complete_lifecycle_cost=null`, `production_qualified=false`. The original mandatory `blocking-ci`, Architecture, owner and true lifecycle gates remain unchanged.
